protocol.preprocessing: Peak normalization, entry/exit removal to 5,000 samples, third-order polynomial VB fit, five sub-runs per run, MAD-based outlier treatment
protocol.features: 152 MATLAB Diagnostic Feature Designer descriptors; fully-grown RF ranking to 15; 32,767 feature combinations
protocol.validation: Randomized 70% training / 30% testing, not a documented whole-tool-case exclusion
protocol.labels: Paper Table 3 lists Fresh 0–0.15 mm, Worn 0.15–0.30 mm, Failed 0.30–0.45 mm; boundary inclusion and handling beyond 0.45 mm require reconciliation with our ≥0.30 mm class
protocol.cohort: 167 original runs; five-way segmentation described as 835 segments; classification description gives 640 data points (215 Fresh, 248 Worn, 177 Failed); Figure 8 test matrices contain 192 segments.

notes: Table 7 provides separate material accuracies, not separate material confusion matrices or score vectors. Macro-F1, AUC, UER and Failed recall are therefore unavailable for those rows.
Figure 8 supports reconstruction of accuracy, Macro-F1, UER, Failed recall and Failed→Fresh for its pooled segment test set. AUC cannot be reconstructed from a hard confusion matrix.

The abstract/discussion reports 95.8% for a current-only material ensemble. Figure 9 is not used to assign missing per-material metrics because its figure values and narrative do not uniquely identify a consistent matching current-only confusion matrix.
The test unit, label synthesis, class range, train/test split, features and learners differ from our whole-case results. Do not report a percentage-point improvement as a matched experiment.
